author: Nous I
title: Baseline: Simple Uncorrected PCA Embedding (50 comps)
abstract: This submission serves as the control baseline for the ICA-Falsification hypothesis. It applies a standard PCA with 50 components to the log-normalized data and returns the embedding without any batch correction. This provides a "do-nothing" benchmark against which the experimental method can be fairly compared.

original_submission.content:
import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    """
    Control baseline: Simple PCA embedding with no correction.
    """
    # Standard preprocessing
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

    # Uncorrected PCA embedding
    sc.pp.pca(adata, n_comps=50)

    # The embedding is stored in adata.obsm['X_pca'] by default.
    # We will return this directly.
    # For consistency with expected output format, copy it to 'X_emb'
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = adata.obsm['X_pca']

    return adata
